{"metadata":{"description":"极简·省 token 的 DSH 长期记忆插件：零 LLM 自动捕获、符号索引渐进披露、ESR 证据闭环。Minimalist token-saving memory for DeepSeek Harness: zero-LLM auto-capture, symbolic index, ESR-lite evidence closure.","id":"gh:1338237286","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-engram","slug":"skepsun/dsh-engram","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","long-term-memory","memory","pi-esr"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"极简·省 token 的 DSH 长期记忆插件：零 LLM 自动捕获、符号索引渐进披露、ESR 证据闭环。Minimalist token-saving memory for DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ness: zero-LLM auto-capture, symbolic index, ESR-lite evidence closure."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-engram"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **English · 中文**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Minimalist long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, distilled from the

with one goal: **save tokens**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Zero-LLM intake** — auto-captures meaningful events from tool results by pure

integration**: a completed or blocked goal (`goal/change` session event)

commands and never touches arbitrary paths. All data lives in the single
sto"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"rage-domain unit `~/.dsh/storages/dsh_engram.json` (plus the session-log
